Wildcard Wednesday Night Ride

Traverse City, MI · Mountain bike

Beginner friendly

Wildcard Wednesday Night Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Traverse City, MI. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from VASA Singletrack trailhead lot. Pace: fast, medium and slow/newbie groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: fast, medium and slow/newbie groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @wildcardcycleworks the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wildcard Wednesday Night Ride group ride

The Traverse City mountain bike shop ride. Multiple groups by speed, including a slow group for new riders. Snacks and drinks at the trailhead afterward.
